children: IFF reported Q3 2026 sales of $1.942 billion, up 4% year over year, and adjusted EBITDA of $403 million, up 5%. It raised 2026 sales and EBITDA outlooks, while flagging lower Q4 profitability.
International Flavors & Fragrances (IFF) beat third-quarter sales and adjusted EPS expectations, driven by broad-based volume growth across its divisions.
International Flavors & Fragrances completed its $500 million accelerated share repurchase program. Its planned Food Ingredients separation remains on schedule for completion by the end of Q2 2027.
IFF reported third-quarter comparable currency-neutral sales growth in Taste, Scent and Health & Biosciences. Segment adjusted EBITDA rose 6%, led by 10% growth in Scent and 7% in Taste.
IFF agreed to sell its Food Ingredients business, with the deal expected to close in Q2 2027. SCL was classified as discontinued operations.
IFF completed a $500 million share buyback. The company expects higher costs and Health & Biosciences reinvestment to pressure profits, especially in the fourth quarter.
IFF’s average 12-month price target rose to $98.25 from $97.62 across 16 analysts, implying about 7% upside from its Nov. 3 close. Targets ranged from $76 to $110; the consensus rating remained Buy.
